name: 44405 · Campbell, OH
findings: ZIP 44405 (Campbell) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (67% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44405 (Campbell) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
